requirements.title: Saving a working directory as a checkpoint
requirements.rationale: An agent's uncommitted and unpushed work must survive the end of the compute it was made on.

criteria.condition: a checkpoint is taken of a `ready` sandbox whose working directory is a git repository
criteria.action: store a ref `refs/parley/sandboxes/<sandbox id>/<branch>` in the sandbox's workspace for every local branch whose head commit the workspace's repository does not have and for the checked-out branch when the working tree has uncommitted changes, saving those changes (new files that git does not ignore included, ignored files excluded) as one extra commit on top of the branch head, and leave the branch heads, the index and the working tree inside the sandbox as they were
criteria.contract: the sandbox's `checkpoint` is `{at: the clock's time in whole seconds UTC, ok: true, error: null, refs: [{branch, sha, dirty}]}` sorted by branch, where each `sha` is the 40-character id the ref resolves to and `dirty` is true only for a ref that ends in the extra commit; one `parley.sandbox.checkpoint` event exists with `resource_type` `sandbox`, `resource_id` the sandbox id, the sandbox's `workspace` and `session_id`, and metadata `{ok, refs, error}` equal to the record's

requirements.title: Starting a sandbox again
requirements.rationale: A stopped or ended sandbox still holds the agent's working directory; starting it again is cheaper than building a new one.

criteria.condition: a caller with write access sends `POST /api/v1/workspaces/{slug}/sandboxes/{id}/start` for a sandbox in state `stopped`, `completed` or `failed`

criteria.contract: HTTP 200 with the sandbox object in `state` `provisioning`; the event's actor is the caller; when the provisioning work has run, the sandbox is `ready`, the runtime was given the secret values as they are now (a value rotated while the sandbox was stopped is the one used), the main `command` was started again when the sandbox has one, and the earlier hub credential still answers HTTP 401
